configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimized native build with the zero-warning policy (audit task 0.1).

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Debug build instrumented with -fsanitize=address,undefined and -fno-sanitize-recover=all (any sanitizer finding fails the test). The python_import_smoke ctest is excluded here: loading an instrumented module into an uninstrumented CPython is unsupported by the toolchain and meaningless for finding engine bugs. Benchmarks are disabled here (PDTK_ENABLE_BENCHMARKS=OFF, ADR-0005).

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: Debug build instrumented with -fsanitize=thread. Foundation for the concurrency tests of issue-1 tasks 6.1-6.3; today's suite is single-threaded, so this verifies instrumentation, linking and a clean baseline. python_import_smoke is excluded for the same reason as in the asan preset. Benchmarks are disabled here (PDTK_ENABLE_BENCHMARKS=OFF, ADR-0005).

configurePresets.name: msan
configurePresets.description: CI-only preset: GCC does not implement -fsanitize=memory (docs/recovery/problem-registry.md P-008), and a meaningful MSan run requires every linked library (including the C++ standard library) to be instrumented, i.e. a clang + MSan-instrumented libc++ toolchain. Configure with a clang toolchain, e.g.: CC=clang CXX=clang++ cmake --preset msan. Benchmarks are disabled here (PDTK_ENABLE_BENCHMARKS=OFF, ADR-0005).
